title: A radio story for the neighborhood hour
titleZh: 社區廣播時段的故事投稿
passage:
Document 1 — Station call for contributions
BAY COMMUNITY RADIO | This month’s neighborhood hour

Choose one of two formats. A spoken postcard is a recording of 60 seconds or less and must be submitted by Sunday night. A live chat is a two-minute conversation with our host; book it by Friday at noon. Both formats can describe the same kinds of local places.

For the recorded format, do not add background music. A place’s own sounds may stay in the recording if listeners can still hear every word. For live chats, the host can play a short sound after the conversation, but not underneath it. Mention any sound you want played in the booking note so we can check it in advance.

If an entry mentions a place that is temporarily closed or not publicly accessible, describe it from outside and avoid giving directions for entering. We still welcome a story about the place.

Give the place’s current street name in the title, even if you use its old name in the story. If you leave your name off the form, the host will introduce you as “a neighbor.”

Document 2 — Note drafted by a contributor
I’m writing this on Friday at 1 p.m. My draft is a forty-five-second account of the old tram shed. It describes the glass doors from the street. I also give directions for getting through a little side door, which I used when I worked there. The shed is closed to the public while the city checks the roof.

I recorded bells from the street and mixed in a short piano tune. The bells are clear but don’t drown out my words. I can remove the piano or make another recording this weekend. The piano tune is my own, and I was hoping the station could play it while I tell the story. Is that still possible this month?

The draft title uses the former street name, Ferry Row. It’s Canal Street now. I’d rather leave my name off the form.
passageZh:
文件一｜電台徵件公告
海灣社區電台｜本月社區時段

請從兩種形式選一種。「口述明信片」是不超過 60 秒的錄音，須於星期日晚上前提交。「現場訪談」是與主持人對談兩分鐘，須在星期五中午前預約。兩種形式可介紹同類型的本地地點。

錄音形式請勿加入背景音樂。若聽眾仍能聽清楚每個詞，就可以保留地點本身的聲音。現場訪談中，主持人可在對話結束後播放一小段聲音，但不能在對話進行時當成背景播放。若希望播放某段聲音，請在預約備註中提及，讓我們先確認。

若作品介紹暫時關閉或不對公眾開放的地點，請從外面描述，不要提供如何進入的指引。我們仍歡迎分享那個地點的故事。

即使故事裡用的是舊地名，標題也請採用該地目前的街名。如果表單不填姓名，主持人會用「一位鄰居」介紹你。

文件二｜投稿者的草稿備註
我寫這份備註時是星期五下午一點。我的草稿是 45 秒的舊電車庫故事，從街上描述玻璃門，也提供如何從小側門進去的指引。我以前在那裡工作時用過這扇門。電車庫在市府檢查屋頂期間暫不對外開放。

我在街上錄到鐘聲，另外混入一小段鋼琴曲。鐘聲清楚，但沒有蓋過我說的話。這個週末我可以去掉鋼琴聲，或重新錄一段。那段鋼琴曲是我自己寫的，我原本希望電台在我講故事時播放。這個月還有可能嗎？

草稿的標題用了這條街的舊名「渡口街」。現在叫「運河街」。我想讓表單上的姓名欄留白。
